definitions.explanation: Deep darkness or absence of light. Can also refer figuratively to a dark, hidden, or unknowable aspect of something.
Illegal or underground activities, especially buying and selling goods outside legal channels. Used as a prefix to mean "illegal" or "underground."

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{闇|やみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧。
examples.english: The dark side of the case runs deep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{闇|やみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{紛|まぎ}れて→紛れる：07572_magireru⟧⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: He escaped under cover of the night's darkness.

examples.japanese: {闇|やみ}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was traded on the black market.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{闇|やみ}{市|いち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: After the war, many people obtained food at black markets.

examples.japanese: {闇|やみ}⟦バイト→バイト：06955_baito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More and more young people are being arrested for getting involved in illegal part-time jobs.

notes:
SENSE 1 (darkness):
Literal darkness, but also commonly used figuratively for the hidden, corrupt, or unknowable side of things.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (sense 1):
- {闇|やみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧ (in the darkness)
- {闇|やみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧ (to be shrouded in darkness)
- {闇|やみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{紛|まぎ}れる→紛れる：07572_magireru⟧ (to disappear into the darkness)
- {闇|やみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧ (the darkness runs deep)

SENSE 2 (black market / illicit):
Used as a prefix meaning "illegal" or "underground."

COMMON COMPOUNDS (sense 2):
- {闇|やみ}{市|いち}/{闇|やみ}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ (black market)
- {闇|やみ}⟦バイト→バイト：06955_baito⟧ (illegal part-time job — a recent social problem in Japan)
- ⟦{闇|やみ}{取引|とりひき}→闇取引：18918_yamitorihiki⟧ (illicit dealings)
- {闇|やみ}{金|がね} (slush fund; illicit money)
